text: LC[m, n, r, s] evaluates to 4-dimensional \varepsilon^{m n r s} by virtue of applying FeynCalcInternal.

When some indices of a Levi-Civita-tensor are contracted with 4-vectors, FeynCalc suppresses explicit dummy indices by putting those vectors into the corresponding index slots. For example, \varepsilon^{p_1 p_2 p_3 p_4} (accessible via LC[][p1,p2,p3,p4]) correspond to \varepsilon_{\mu \nu \rho \sigma} p_1^\mu p_2^\nu p_3^\rho p_4^\sigma.
LC[\[Mu], \[Nu], \[Rho], \[Sigma]] // FCI // StandardForm (*Eps[LorentzIndex[\[Mu]], LorentzIndex[\[Nu]], LorentzIndex[\[Rho]], LorentzIndex[\[Sigma]]]*)
LC[\[Mu], \[Nu]][p, q] // FCI // StandardForm (*Eps[LorentzIndex[\[Mu]], LorentzIndex[\[Nu]], Momentum[p], Momentum[q]]*)
LC[\[Mu], \[Nu], \[Rho], \[Sigma]] FV[Subscript[p, 1], \[Mu]] FV[Subscript[p, 2], \[Nu]] FV[Subscript[p, 3], \[Rho]] FV[Subscript[p, 4], \[Sigma]] Contract[%]
